status_definitions.OK: Reviewed representation and cited checks support this row’s scoped evidence requirement; not approval, exhaustive validation or runtime proof.
status_definitions.CHANGE REQUIRED: A reproduced current defect undermines this row; any associated joint decisions remain pending.
status_definitions.OPEN: Paths exist in part but exact semantics/configuration/ownership evidence or joint decision is still missing; no asserted confirmed defect for that gap.
